responsibility: Declares the Rust resolver’s special ICE diagnostic finalizer hook. This header exposes funny_ice_text_finalizer, the no-return function with GCC diagnostic_text_output_format and diagnostic_info parameters that is installed for the frontend’s deliberate resolver-phase easter-egg ICE path, separating that custom output behavior from the ordinary name-resolution visitors and scope machinery in this module.
same_name_distinction: Declares the funny_ice_text_finalizer diagnostic hook and documents the intentional "break rust"/"break gcc" resolver ICE behavior; unlike the .cc peer, it exposes the interface and rationale rather than the executable finalization logic.
